diagnostic.result: Current final flow gate changes from no facing violation to one facing violation in all four reflections when only the non-output test point moves.
diagnostic.scope: Invokes the actual check_pcb_placement_flow implementation with explicit policy and model origins. No footprints or routing supplied; not a physically qualified board. The anchored dot is a diagnostic control, not a proposed hardware acceptance metric.

implementation_findings.centroid: FinalGeometry in pcb_placement_flow_gate.cpp averages all instance origins by sheet, without regard to electrical role or face.
implementation_findings.gate: The output-role centroid must have positive dot product toward the downstream centroid; zero/negative fails the final flow gate.
implementation_findings.planner: pcb_placement_build.cpp derives enforced facing terms from external.downstream/output_roles and wired membership. Reported basis is facing/output_roles [placement/v2], not a physical limit citation.
implementation_findings.history: 226bfb83 aligned compact planner checks with the final hard gate after a negative-facing layout had been accepted by guarded planner semantics. That was a consistency repair, not evidence that an all-component centroid is a physically invariant acceptance rule.

hardware_review.document: SNVSBD5D Rev. D, July 2022, section 11.1 page 47
hardware_review.observation: The layout guidance covers local switching loops, bypass/boot/feedback geometry, ground plane, wide/direct power paths, thermal copper and small SW area. It does not specify the tested all-component-centroid 90-degree cutoff. Other devices and requirements need their own review.

next_change_requirements: Represent any reviewed heuristic as an explicit advisory with provenance; do not silently drop failures or change every contract at once.
Keep unresolved roles/geometry visibly UNRESOLVED and preserve required local hot-loop, capacitor, feedback, clearance and connectivity checks.
Keep planner, final flow gate, composition reporting, work receipts and tests consistent with the same declared policy.
Preserve physical connector-access/orientation constraints; centroid-based subsystem preference is a different concept.
Screen candidate layouts and fully qualify accepted finalists; routing, parasitics and thermal performance cannot be inferred from a centroid metric.
limits: No production policy or acceptance rule changed in this commit. No new smaller board or fabrication-readiness claim.
